text.tspan: From a candidate biomarker to inferred biological factors
A biomarker from BiomarkerKB is linked to diseases; overlapping CFDE REVEAL gene–trait–factor evidence maps those diseases back to candidate biological mechanisms.
roles and record support from BiomarkerKB
ranked by gene and disease support
A candidate mechanism is linked to the biomarker through associated diseases and overlapping CFDE gene–trait–factor evidence; it is not automatically a validated mechanism of the biomarker.
Support across multiple diseases and gene-linked factors strengthens the hypothesis, but different diseases may still involve different biological mechanisms.didate biomarker is
linked to the factor through genetically associated diseases; it is not automatically a direct biomarker of the factor.
